reason: PURE. The first thing I saw was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, and a named ISO 17025 lab is more than most brands give me. I fly every few weeks, so single sachets that fit in a carry-on are handy, and I would buy one box to test the QR report and the capsules.
objection: It is not NSF or USP certified, and with no reviews I only have the brand's own word that the QR report is real. Also two capsules a day at this size are probably hard to swallow, and $1 a day is more than the magnesium I buy now.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP mark, or a QR report I open and check that matches the lot number on my sachet, plus a smaller or easier-to-swallow capsule.
